about: Whether a value is an email address by the rule docs/DECISIONS.md records under
"An email address is judged by one rule, in the form and in the backend".
Both implementations run every vector: EmailAddresses (EmailAddressesTest, backend) and
isValidEmailAddress in frontend/src/lib/compose/addresses.ts, so a rule changed in one and not
the other fails a build. EmailAddressesTest also sends every valid vector through the parsers
the send and the draft use, so the rule cannot accept an address the send path then refuses.
The values carry no whitespace around them: the frontend trims before it judges, the backend
judges a value its request record has already stripped.
Characters outside ASCII are written as \u escapes on purpose: a reviewer cannot tell a
composed letter from a decomposed one, or a no-break space from a space, otherwise.
